title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Job Title: Product Manager

Location: 100% REMOTE!
Salary: $120-150k/year + benefits

Requirements: Experience in digital product management; agency or in-house ecommerce environment; Shopify; strategy experience

Backed by the same leaders of a first of it's kind ecommerce company (does 100M in revenue), we are a digital product studio focused on building a team and process that allows high impact work! Our expertise in ecommerce is unparalleled and are looking for team members who seek an opportunity to rise with us!

Our work is grounded in our three pillars: 1) data-driven decisions, 2) impact-first designs, and 3) elegant technology solutions. We've been working with leading e-commerce brands since our inception and have created so much value that we have customers waiting in line!

We're currently looking for a Senior Product Manager who can own client relationships, shape product direction, and lead cross-functional teams to execution. You'll serve as the connective tissue between clients, designers, developers, and stakeholders-balancing vision with velocity.

What you need for this position:

3+ years of experience in digital product management
MUST HAVE demonstrated product strategy capability, including shaping roadmap direction, running A/B tests, interpreting data to drive decisions, and advising clients on strategic tradeoffs that align product outcomes with business goals
Proven success in agency or in-house ecommerce environments working with ecommerce brands
Strong understanding of Shopify ecosystem, including themes, apps, checkout, and analytics
Strategy experience: Track record in product strategy, A/B testing, and data-driven decision-making
Full product lifecycle ownership experience
Comfortable interfacing with technical teams
Project management expertise
Client leadership skills: Ability to lead client conversations independently

What you'll be doing:

Lead product strategy for Shopify-based ecommerce experiences, from discovery to launch and iteration
Translate business goals into product roadmaps, user stories, and success metrics
Manage day-to-day project delivery across agile pods (design, dev, QA), ensuring timelines and budgets are met
Serve as the primary client contact-facilitating workshops, presenting roadmaps, and building trust
Collaborate with UX, design, and engineering to prioritize features and optimize user flows
Identify growth opportunities through CRO, retention, and personalization strategies
Contribute to internal process improvements and mentor junior PMs or strategists

Benefits

- Comprehensive Health Coverage: We cover 100% of your medical and dental insurance premiums-because your well-being matters.
- Generous Time Off: Enjoy 15 days of paid time off annually, plus 12 paid holidays across the U.S. and Canada.
- Paid Winter Break: We shut down during the final week of the year so the whole team can recharge-fully paid.
- Sick Leave: You'll have 5 paid sick days each year to rest and recover when needed.
- Remote-First Culture: Work from anywhere in North America with at least 4 hours of overlap with Pacific Time. We're headquartered in Los Angeles, but our team is distributed.
- Professional Growth Time: We set aside dedicated time each month for learning-whether that's courses, internal projects, industry events, networking, or coaching.
- Home Office Setup: We'll provide a Mac and contribute to your remote workspace. Need something to stay productive or make your setup shine? Just ask.
